title: 3-day legal triage & invoice sprint
content:
Fast scratchpad for the next 72 hours — mix of small finance checks + quick contract redlines. Keep it lean.

High-level goal:
- Clear the short backlog of invoice exceptions + push two contract renewals to negotiated language or escalation.
- Leave inbox with no urgent finance/legal items for the week.

DAY 1 (Wed) \u2014 invoice triage sprint
- Morning: invoice exceptions (target 8)
  - INV-2026-014: vendor claim for GPU credits. Line items mismatch: billed 9 vs usage 7. Ask billing to pull raw usage csv and run 24h window. Slack Tom if not returned by 16:00.
  - INV-2026-019: late fee flagged but PO missing. Quick fix: confirm PO with Procurement (Leah). If PO not found, hold payment and note dispute.
  - INV-2026-023: duplicate charge suspected. Mark "on hold", attach screenshot, add comment to JIRA-7890.
- Afternoon: payments schedule sanity check
  - Quick calc: expected outflow this week ~ $172k (rough). Major line: infra reserved capacity. Reconcile with Finance sheet (Confluence-2345).
  - If short by >$10k vs budget slice, flag to CFO pulse.

DAY 2 (Thu) \u2014 contract mini-redline
- Vendor: EdgeStore (renewal due 2026-04-02)
  - Must: tighten data residency clause (appendix A), shorten auto-renew to 30 days notice, add explicit SLA credits table.
  - My quick redline plan: reuse clause language from last year's Dedicated vendor template (search: "dedicated-template-v2" in drive).
  - Questions: can we accept 99.5% monthly SLO? ops says no for production models. Put fallback: canary routing until full performance validation.
- NDA-ish MSA: micro-terms for SSO+KMS access
  - Remove broad "access to system" phrasing; restrict to named service accounts only.
  - Add audit log requirement: 90 days retention for access events.

DAY 3 (Fri) \u2014 renewal reminders + followups
- Chase procurement for PO for INV-2026-019. Deadline EOD Fri.
- Send proposed EdgeStore redline (PDF) to Leah + Tom for quick 1-hr sync (aim 10:30 PT).
- Renewal watchlist (top of page)
  - EdgeStore: 2026-04-02 (action: redline sent by Thu EOD)
  - ModelBench Pro: 2026-05-10 (note: upcoming pricing change, hold call until Ops confirms monthly token forecasts)

Quick notes / heuristics (personal)
- If invoice has >3 line-item disputes, escalate to Leah and mark as "procurement review".
- Anything claiming credits >$5k: ask for raw usage + signed request from vendor ops.
- For renewals: prefer 30-60 day negotiation window; never accept auto-renew without notice < 30 days.

Open questions / TODOs (short):
- [ ] Confirm raw usage CSV for INV-2026-014 (Tom)
- [ ] Find last year's dedicated-template-v2 (drive search) and copy clauses into EdgeStore redline (me)
- [ ] Confirm whether SLO credit table needs legal signoff or ops signoff first (Leah)
- [ ] Update JIRA-7890 with duplicate charge evidence (attach screenshots)

Random fragments / notes to self:
- call with procurement bumped to Fri if Leah can't get PO
- keep redline polite & commercial; avoid starting with "we require" list
- if EdgeStore pushes hard on auto-renew, offer a 12-mo with 60-day notice + step-down price for first 3 months

Meeting prep bullets (for Thu sync)
- 3 bullets: 1) data residency fix (what we want), 2) SLA minimum (what we accept), 3) renewal cadence + termination notice

End-of-day always: quick inbox triage, mark items that need follow-up on Monday, close everything else.

— Nina

(temporary scratchpad: will refine into a proper redline doc if things escalate)
